biological_reference.divergence: LOAD-BEARING: read directly from ree_core/agent.py -- update_liking() (line 10287) writes VALENCE_LIKING from raw benefit_exposure (threshold-gated); update_benefit_salience() writes VALENCE_WANTING from serotonin.benefit_salience(benefit_exposure), a smoothed/calibrated transform of the SAME underlying signal. Unlike the biological system's genuinely separate dopamine/opioid pathways, the current implementation derives both channels from one shared input via different transforms -- collinearity is close to guaranteed by construction, independent of environment richness or behavioral manipulation.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-887 (2026-08-04, FAIL, node_valence_collapsible_to_composite): SD-014's first-ever genuine experimental evidence (previously lit_conf=0.868, experimental_confidence=0 across 4 prior non_contributory/measurement-gap runs). Readiness gate green, instrument-verified (orthogonal synthetic control confirms the tau/rho statistics detect separability when present), non-degenerate. Both load-bearing criteria fail on every seed: C1 (drive-gating) tau 0.87-0.89 vs 0.85 ceiling; C2 (separability) rho(w,l) 0.93-0.97 vs 0.90 ceiling. Source-level root cause (this session, ree_core/agent.py:10230-10309): update_liking() and update_benefit_salience()/VALENCE_WANTING both derive from the same raw benefit_exposure signal via different transforms -- not independent pathways the way real dopamine-wanting/opioid-liking systems are. Eliminated AS CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED, with a concrete buildable fix (decouple wanting's computation from raw benefit_exposure, e.g. an incentive-sensitization term per Smith/Berridge/Aldridge 2011 so wanting can diverge from liking over repeated exposure). A retest after that fix opens a fresh hypothesis rather than resolving this one.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Decouple VALENCE_WANTING's write-path from raw benefit_exposure so wanting and liking are computed from genuinely independent signals
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Currently ree_core/agent.py::update_liking() writes VALENCE_LIKING from raw benefit_exposure (threshold-gated at liking_threshold), while update_benefit_salience() writes VALENCE_WANTING from serotonin.benefit_salience(benefit_exposure) -- a smoothed/EMA-calibrated transform of the SAME input. Introduce an incentive-sensitization mechanism for wanting (per Smith/Berridge/Aldridge 2011: dopamine sensitization increases wanting without increasing liking) so wanting can diverge from raw hedonic magnitude over repeated exposure/training -- e.g. a separate, learnable gain term on VALENCE_WANTING that is not a monotone function of the same benefit_exposure liking reads. Confirmed unblocking test: V3-EXQ-887's own instrument (orthogonal synthetic control) is already validated and can be reused to retest C1/C2 once the write-path changes.

cluster_pattern.shape: N independent bugs/questions swept in one governance cycle, not one structural property
readings: Across five independent claim-lineages, four of six FAILs are lettered iterations (3rd or 4th generation) where each successive letter fixed the PRIOR letter's diagnosed defect and still failed -- but for a genuinely NEW reason each time (875/875a: readiness fix revealed seed-dependent bimodality; 867b: power-guard fix revealed a screening-methodology falsification; 436d: substrate fix revealed a baseline anomaly). This recurring shape -- fix-the-diagnosed-defect, still fail, for a different reason -- is common enough across unrelated claims this cycle to be worth naming as a pattern in its own right, even though the underlying MECHANISMS are unrelated: iterative same-design re-queuing tends to surface successive INSTRUMENTATION/DESIGN layers rather than converging on a claim-level verdict, and each of those three cases was routed toward either a genuinely different measurement approach or a targeted diagnostic rather than a further same-design letter.

The other two targets (887/SD-014, 848b/ARC-005) are the CONTROL CASE for that pattern: both are lettered/staged iterations that DID reach a clean, decisive-enough reading once their respective instrumentation gaps were closed -- 887 by finding the actual literature-divergent root cause in source, 848b by resolving into a well-characterized (if still underpowered) real effect rather than an ambiguous artifact.
